claims.quote: Potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily B member 1 (KCNB1) encodes Kv2.1 potassium channel.

claims.object_text: global developmental delay, behavioral disorders, and various epilepsies
claims.quote: KCNB1 mutations are known to cause global developmental delay, behavioral disorders, and various epilepsies.

claims.object_text: intrafamilial phenotypic variability and relatively mild clinical findings
claims.quote: Our study shows that frameshift mutation cytoplasmic domain of KCNB1 gene can cause intrafamilial phenotypic variability and relatively mild clinical findings in these patients.
